children: WSFS Financial Corp. reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $59.1 million, up 28.2% from $46.1 million a year earlier, as net interest income increased 6.8% to $196.6 million. Diluted earnings per share rose to $1.75 from $1.37.
Net interest income was $196.6M, compared with $184.0M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 6.8%.
Net income was $59.1M, compared with $46.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 28.2%.
Diluted EPS was $1.75, compared with $1.37 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 27.7%.
Noninterest income rose 30% year over year, led by fees from Institutional Services, BMT-DE and Private Wealth Management.
Loans and leases grew 1.2% in the quarter, while deposits increased 4.2% year to date, driven mainly by Institutional Services and Commercial.
WSFS sold its $36.3M credit card portfolio and partnered to issue WSFS-branded cards.
NewLane Finance serves small businesses nationwide, while Cash Connect supports about 22,900 non-bank ATMs and 12,100 smart safes.
The company served clients through 115 offices across six states, as well as its ATM network, website and mobile app.
